purpose: Make the xtask controlled harness deterministic when a fixture child leaves a controlled descendant or inherited capture descriptor behind.

scope.registered_surface: tools/xtask and its foundational test fixture only

contract: callers provide a complete command, working directory, explicit environment, input, output, cancellation signal, and deadline
the owner creates one Unix process group, reconciles that group, owns input and capture workers, and returns a closed typed outcome
the owner clears ambient child environment and quality supplies an explicit bounded PATH, toolchain-path, locale, timezone, temporary-directory, and certificate-path snapshot
fixture control paths are embedded in the synthetic git program instead of inherited through the outer xtask environment
quality documentation builds use a unique temporary target, and EG-DOCS scans the full generated rustdoc root without secret-scan exclusions
change.ownership_boundary: The owner reconciles only its direct child and the process group it created. It does not claim control over a hostile descendant that intentionally escapes that group.
unchanged: all registered gate identities, profiles, timeout values, retries, nextest grouping, result semantics, and retained M0-02 LEAK evidence
application scope state, dependencies, unsafe-code policy, and Release 1 qualification status

detection_gained: a deterministic public FIFO regression fails closed when a controlled descendant retains stdout or stderr after its direct parent exits
typed launch, non-zero, deadline, cancellation, capture-limit, descendant, and cleanup-path outcomes are exercised through the controlled owner
parallel reordered invocations retain separate descriptors and explicit environments
an empty-specification child cannot inherit the test runner environment
generated rustdoc secret canaries are rejected without permitting an artifact or detector fingerprint
detection_lost: none; existing gates and the retained negative M0-02 LEAK evidence remain intact

migration.from: quality.rs spawned and waited on direct children while capture readers could remain blocked on inherited descriptors
migration.to: quality.rs delegates all affected fixture commands to the controlled owner and receives only reconciled verdicts or typed failures
migration.fixture_protocol: The retained synthetic git fixture embeds quoted FIFO and pid paths; it uses an explicit readiness file and release FIFO rather than timing or inherited test-control variables.

failed because inherited parent environment exceeded the 1024-byte controlled capture limit

green.result: 20 owner/unit tests and 43 public foundational fixture tests passed after the explicit environment and process-group migration
